features: Easy to Use: The Mini nanny Cam supports Wi-Fi remote view, Low Aangle video Recording, shoot photos through the free phone APP . It also supports playback video(recorded on the SD card) on phone. The set-up is very easy, you can follow the directions in the user manual step-by-step.

Loop Recording: When the memory card is full, the newest File will overwrite the previous File, and the device will continue recording with continuous-loop videotaping. It will automatically save new video files in per 10 minutes. You will never miss the important thing you want to know. (Tip: we recommend that you organize files in time, to avoid deleting important video File)

Wide Viewing Angle: The camera is equipped with a Lower angle lens, enabling it to cover for small Space like Cashiers Cash Counters for Monitoring cash transactions and capture comprehensive footage.
